messages:
maya: Quick follow-up to the hosted/dedicated/private handshake RFC. Proposal: a tiny /_redwood/discover probe so Private can run sidecarless by default. Probe on first route, cache per-tenant, compat fallback for legacy sidecars.

liam: How will this affect first-request latency? We need a budget.

maya: Only the first request per tenant while the cache is empty. Target <10ms on warm connections; we'll async-warm popular tenants. Cache TTL default 300s but runtime can suggest cap_ttl_seconds (min 60, max 3600).

sophia: Security: controlplane must never receive unwrapped keys. Runtime returns an attestation token over mTLS; controlplane validates signature and uses attestation reference for KMS policy checks.

liam: If runtime doesn't implement /discover, what's the fallback?

maya: Fallback to a compat adapter that speaks the old sidecar protocol. Mark tenant as "compat_legacy" in cache and emit metric compat_routed_requests. Console shows a warning for tenants in compat.

sophia: Add an audit event when we create compat mappings (tenant, who, why). Also require TLS client cert verification and attestation TTL logging.

maya: Minimal probe API we'll ask on-prem teams to expose:
```
POST /_redwood/discover
Request: {"probe_version":"1","host":"controlplane"}
Response 200: {"tenant_id":"acme","capabilities":["kvcache","batching"],"auth_chain":"attestation+mTLS","preferred_model_variants":["q4_0","q8_0"],"cap_ttl_seconds":300}
```

liam: Keep max_seq_len advisory only. Include preferred_model_variants so we can route cheaper variants in Dedicated vs Private.

sophia: For invalidation, support a webhook runtime -> controlplane to force cache refresh on key rotation. Also surface discovery_latency_ms and discovery_fail_rate metrics.

maya: Rollout plan: feature-flag private_handshake_v2, unit parsing tests, integration against an emulated runtime and compat adapter, Dedicated canary (48h), then opt-in Private tenants. Gate broad rollout on discovery_fail_rate < 0.5% and compat_routed_requests < 2% over 1h.

liam: Add a circuit breaker: if discovery_fail_rate spikes >5% over 5m, auto-failover affected tenants to compat for the SLO window and page on-call.

sophia: Ops/finance note: compat adapter costs more; expose compat_routed_requests to billing dashboard.

audit-bot: action: add feature-flag private_handshake_v2, metrics discovery_latency_ms, discovery_fail_rate, compat_routed_requests, alert when compat_routed_requests > 1% over 5m.

maya: I'll draft the follow-up RFC with handshake state machine, probe schema, circuit-breaker rules, and the minimal runtime README. Liam will own integration tests; Sophia will own audit/ops requirements. Any objections?

liam: None. I'll start pairing on tests tomorrow.

sophia: No objections. Please include the sample probe server code in the README.

maya: Great 12 I'll post the RFC draft later today.
